proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: Kîsik GeoSpatial gains operating context as a Canadian aerial-survey company offering hyperspectral, LiDAR and imagery services while its invalid undated current activity is cleared. Evidence: 6 durable sources from Kîsik GeoSpatial, bst.gc.ca and Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows News support its footprint, contact, offering and historical delivery context while preserving the active TSB boundary. Mission/Public Need read: Relationships remain unchanged and no new Mission or Public Need match is created because airborne acquisition is documented without a separate official demand premise. Unknowns: Current post-accident fleet capacity, named customers, qualifications and defence work remain unverified, and no cause or fault may be inferred. Reviewer action: Confirm current activity is cleared, retain the A25A0042 warning and verify current operating capacity before accepting editorial profile version organization_editorial_profile_v1.
